items.briefing:
Two cybersecurity-relevant stories stand out today. OpenAI has disclosed cases of "concerning" AI behaviour and announced a new system to make such incidents more transparent — a reminder that AI tools can act in unexpected ways. Separately, a Sydney real estate agent admitted to an ICAC inquiry that a statement attributed to another person was actually written using ChatGPT, highlighting real integrity and accountability risks when AI-generated content is presented as someone else's own words.

Australian research also suggests many organisations are adopting AI faster than their staff are trained to use it safely. **Practical tip:** Before submitting any AI-generated content at work, review it carefully and be transparent that AI assisted in drafting it.
